records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased by $9.7 million, or 8.5%, during the three months ended September 30, 2025, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2024, primarily due to the rationalization of underperforming business and plants and lower volumes.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of sales decreased by $10.7 million, or 11.0%, during the three months ended September 30, 2025, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2024, primarily due to the decrease in sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Interest expense increased by $0.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2024, primarily due to average debt balances, interest rates and amortization of debt issuance costs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: These decreases were partially offset by contribution of new business launches, higher precious metals pass-through pricing and favorable foreign exchange effects of $0.8 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations increased by $2.9 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025 compared to the same period in the prior year, primarily due improved margins and lower compensation costs due to headcount reductions.
